source.note: No Java, JMeter, JVM, GUI, display server, or subprocess was run while creating this corpus.

validation_contract.validator_scope: static schema, profile-reference, XML topology, disabled-content, and input-hash checks only
validation_contract.comparator_scope: JMX GUI round-trip comparison is not implemented; this descriptor is a declarative preservation contract, not captured saved JMX evidence
validation_contract.activation: Enable comparison only after a dedicated JMX GUI comparator and pinned oracle evidence are recorded.

preservation_rules: Every guiclass, testclass, testname, and enabled attribute is retained on load/save, including the nested LoopController.
The source contains an empty WorkBench pair, but JMeter 5.6.3 discards an empty WorkBench when loading into the GUI tree; the saved tree therefore has no WorkBench sibling.
Typed properties retain insertion order, explicit empty values, XML-decoded Unicode, and the disabled sampler subtree.
The disabled sampler carries the opaque jmeter-rs.gui.opaque.disabled stringProp as a no-drop probe; it is not a plugin property and its XML-decoded value must remain exact.
The comparator ignores only XML lexical whitespace and empty-element spelling; it does not normalize GUI class names or node order.

workbench_source_behavior.empty_outcome: discarded during JMeterTreeModel.addSubTree; no saved WorkBench sibling
workbench_source_behavior.nonempty_outcome: migrated into TestPlan as disabled WorkBench Test Fragment or disabled non-test child according to pinned GUI classification

headless_contract.status: planned; no headless process was run

oracle_observation.required_before_promotion: JMeter 5.6.3 GUI load/save on Linux, Windows, and macOS plus headless parser diagnostics
